summary: The annual-panel prototype and bounded genuine-run preparation have passed invented checks; the genuine SIPP panel pilot has not run.

evidence.selection: First 32 canonical lexical SSUIDs from the eligible December identifier/status index, before monetary interpretation; no selection on income, age or weight.
evidence.panel_span: all selected SSUID person-month rows, including all ages, movers and non-December residents
evidence.annual_contributors: December-age15+ contributors, twelve admissible months; missing/structural/unknown universes explicitly withheld; complete subset counts disclosed
evidence.weight_convention: Mean person-month weight of all December members, including children and zero weights.

limitations: Source hash authentication did not parse, select or decode genuine rows and is not a completed panel extraction.
The panel retains the full selected annual person-month span; December contributor sums are a separate measurement choice, not December income multiplied by twelve.
Membership, suppressed slots, source status and unknown annual coverage remain explicit. Source instructions and modeling choices are separate evidence.
No genuine annual-income, fit-accuracy or representative metrics are reported. Cross-survey income and price alignment, housing transfer and validation remain unfinished.
